The screen's search (texting-page.tsx:630-670) calls searchNumbers, which goes to the worker's /v1/telephony/available-numbers (server.ts:440, deps.telephony.searchNumbers). No Assistant tool, screen read or worker tool calls it. manage_phone_number says the person picks the number on the screen, so the Assistant hands over correctly and won't make one up. That corrects the finding's claim that it would make up a number. But it can't do the first step of texting setup ("get me a local 512 number"), and picking a number isn't a settled person-only step.
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_phone_numbers looks for numbers as Get a business number does (local or toll-free, area code or Starts with, digits in the number, city and state, how far out, anywhere) and buys nothing. manage_phone_number gets only the one the person picked, on a card with the number and what it costs. It came with the setup’s Your business number (onb-4) and is the same search.

gaps.where: Settings → Email, the box for an address left behind by someone who left: "Give it to the team", "Give it to them", "Remove it"
gaps.gap: do_email_address_reassign is made from email_address.reassign with no narrowing (coverage.ts:196 is {} with no warning). Its input lets to='remove'. Through private.reassign_email_address, that hard-deletes the person's private conversations on the address and the address row itself ('delete from app.conversations … delete from app.email_addresses'). It also schedules email.remove_files (commands/email.ts:787-796). No bin, no restore. The screen itself warns "It can’t be brought back" (email-page.tsx:302-304). Offering this breaks the settled rule that the Assistant never deletes anything for good. Nothing in tools-screen-actions.ts refuses it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: a screen action can now leave a choice out (notOffered, refused by name with rule not_for_the_assistant). do_email_address_reassign offers giving a left person’s address to the team or to someone, never remove: that deletes the address and its mail for good, which stays the person’s, on Settings → Email. Its own card says whose it was, who gets it, and that its sealed mail opens to them at once.

gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls → Business details (the carrier registration wizard): its eight steps, ending with "Before it goes" and its buttons "Ask HandsFreeOS to check it", "Send to the carriers" or "Pay $X and send". Also "Send again" and "Fix and send again" after a rejection.
gaps.gap: Real: submit_carrier_registration can't get through registration.submit. refuseUnlessAllGreen (registration.ts:128-163) needs a registration_checks row whose fingerprint matches the exact details. Only the worker's /v1/telephony/registration-preflight writes that row (server.ts:560, via registration.record_check), and no Assistant tool calls it. registrationInput (tools-settings-channels.ts:253-279) also builds a BusinessProfile without optInPath, optInUrl, displayName, policyUrl, termsUrl, policyContact, otherWays or confirmed. So even a check run on the screen never matches it. The tool's own advice to send the person to the last step to check "these exact details" can't work. Drafts are real too: withDraft reads only draft['form'] with the wizard's field names (a2p-wizard.tsx:269-292). registration.save_draft's answers are a loose record with no described shape (schemas/telephony.ts:357-362), so an Assistant draft doesn't fill in the wizard. Not right: "can’t send at all". do_registration_request_review is offered (coverage.ts:171) with the full BusinessProfile and notGreen. That gets a registration to the carriers after HandsFreeOS checks it by hand (registration.review.approve, then send). It is also a route for "Send again".
gaps.fix: Fixed: submit_carrier_registration is gone, so nothing promises a send it can’t make. fill_in_carrier_registration fills in the same saved answers the registration’s steps pick up (the wizard’s own fields, how customers agree with its links, the policy contact and the business’s own pages, the topics carriers treat differently) and opens it at How customers agree until what the carriers are told about it is written, then at Before it goes. It clears the ticks given there before, so the person ticks them again on the new answers. Before it goes runs the checks on those exact details, takes the ticks only the person gives and sends: registration.submit is on the not-yet list, and refuseUnlessAllGreen is never skipped. When it won’t go green, do_registration_request_review asks HandsFreeOS to check it by hand.

gaps.where: Settings → Website chat → "Add it to your site": the snippet, Copy, and the "Try it" preview link
gaps.gap: get_settings website_chat returns chat_widget.list as it comes (tools-settings.ts:158). It has publicKey but no snippet and no origin, and chat_widget.get (read_chat_widget_get) has none either. The screen builds `<script async src="${origin}/embed/v1/${publicKey}.js"></script>` with origin = brandedOrigin or the app's (chat-install.tsx:72-77, website-chat-page.tsx:727). Try it is /chat-preview/<key>?w=<workspaceId> (website-chat-page.tsx:815). No assistant tool, prompt.ts or context.ts has the web origin. The worker env does have webUrl (env.ts:674), but the assistant tools don't use it. settings-map's handover says "I set the chat box up and give you the snippet" (settings-map.ts:610), which it can't do without guessing the domain. The create outcome sends the person to the Forms page instead (tools-settings-channels.ts:838).
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_settings (area website_chat) gives each chat’s snippet, as Add it to your site copies it, written out whole on the business’s own domain when one serves (else the web app’s), and its Try it link. The snippet is said once in @hfos/core, for the screen and the Assistant.

gaps.where: Settings → Email → Your own domain: the DNS records (Host and Value with a copy button for each), "Check now", and "Receive mail here" with its MX row (@, priority 10)
gaps.gap: The raw records do reach the Assistant: get_settings email returns EmailDomainOut with dkimHost/dkimValue, returnPathHost/returnPathValue, ownershipHost/ownershipToken and inboundMxHost. So "can’t give the records" is wrong. What's real is that the shape differs from what the screen tells people to type. Hosts are full names, and the screen makes them relative (relativeHost, email-page.tsx:60-62). returnPathValue can be null, and the screen then shows 'pm.mtasv.net' (email-page.tsx:732). The MX record is only a status field, not a row with host @ and priority 10 (email-page.tsx:906-909). There's no type or purpose per record. Also, the add_domain outcome still says "The records to copy are on the Email screen" (tools-settings-channels.ts:509), against the handover's "I … give you the records to copy" (settings-map.ts:571).
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_settings (area email) gives each domain’s records in the screen’s order: the type, what it’s for in the screen’s words, the host to type at the DNS provider (relative to the domain) and the value, and whether the last check found it. emailDomainRecords and relativeHost are in @hfos/core, and Settings → Email uses them too.

gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls while registration is pending: "The carriers are reviewing X" with the rows Number bought, Business profile and brand, Texting campaign and Texting turns on; the fee callout (Pay $X / Pay with another card); "Register for texting now" / "Start the registration" / "Pick up the registration"
gaps.gap: The texting handover tells the person to watch "Carrier registration". That heading is only in the Configured view, which shows when nextStep === 'ready' (texting-page.tsx:307, 1806). gaps.fix: Fixed: settings-map texting names the Steps (Number, Business details, Carrier review), Register for texting now with Start or Pick up the registration, The carriers are reviewing with its rows, Pay and Fix and send again. The registration handover walks through its steps and Before it goes, where it is checked and sent.

gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls → the Phone & texting card: switch (On / Off / Turning on… / Couldn't check), the last error, "Twilio Account SID" and "Sub-account SID" with Copy, and "Numbers already in this account" with "Set it up here"
gaps.gap: Real: lastError, the turning-on state, HandsFreeOS's parent Account SID and "Numbers already in this account" come only from worker endpoints (/v1/telephony/account at server.ts:486-557, /v1/telephony/own-numbers). The Assistant reads none of them. PhoneSetupStatusOutput has only accountStatus (schemas/telephony.ts:527). settings-map texting never names the Phone & texting switch, though do_telephony_enable/disable are offered. Not real: the sub-account SID is reachable once an import exists, as destinationAccountSid in read_number_import_list (queries/number-import.ts:90). transferRequestText is already in core (packages/core/src/messaging/number-import.ts:95), so it doesn't need moving. Only the parent SID is missing to build it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_phone_account reads Phone & texting as its card does: On, Turning on or Off, what went wrong, the Account SID and HandsFreeOS’s parent Account SID, and Numbers already in this account with what each needs. Each number waiting to move here comes with its request to HighLevel’s or Twilio’s support, filled in (core’s transferRequestText). It reads through the same worker logic as the screen’s routes (telephony-reads.ts), as the person, with the same permission check. settings-map texting names the card and turning it on or off.

gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls → the review checklist and what it waits on: Business profile and brand, then Texting campaign, then Texting turns on; and the fee callout
gaps.gap: Nearly all the data is there: get_settings texting returns nextStep, localRegistrationStep (awaiting_approval/rejected/ready), each registration's kind, status, rejectionReason and approvedAt, and textingFees.due. So "why isn’t texting on yet?" can be answered from it. What's missing is the screen's grouping and words, which the model has to work out. It isn't told that an unpaid textingFees.due means nothing has gone to the carriers (the field's doc comment never reaches the model). Nor is it told that customer_profile, trust_product and brand make one row, "Business profile and brand", with "Texting campaign" waiting on it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: settings-map texting’s what says nothing has gone to the carriers while the texting fee is due, and gives the screen’s rows: Business profile and brand, then Texting campaign (which waits for the brand), then texting turns on. No new helper.

gaps.where: Settings → Website chat → the status card: "Who answers" with its notes when the AI teammate is off or not answering website chat
gaps.gap: Part of the data is reachable. Each widget's teammate {id, name, status} is in get_settings website_chat (so 'off' shows), and the teammate's config.channels.chat and widgetId are in get_settings ai_teammate (ai_teammate.get returns the config). What's real is that nothing tells the model the rule that combines them: it answers only when the widget names it, the teammate isn't off, channels.chat is on, and channels.widgetId is null or this widget (editor-data.ts:80). The worker's answerer() note covers off and chat-off only on a change, never widgetId (tools-settings-channels.ts:602-622). So for a second widget, or with the chat channel off, a plain read of website_chat shows a teammate and reads as "the AI answers".
gaps.fix: Fixed: get_settings (area website_chat) gives each chat’s whoAnswers in the screen’s words, from whoAnswersChat in @hfos/core, which the web editor uses too: the teammate named, or that the team answers because the teammate or its Website chat channel is off. manage_website_chat’s card says the same.

gaps.where: Settings → Lead intake, the channel rows: Text, Call, Email, Messenger, Instagram, "Someone fills in your lead ad's form" and "Indeed emails you about an applicant", each with "Open a lead as well as the customer", "Leads land in", "At most N a day"
gaps.gap: Only onScreen's first line is short: it names Text, Call and Email only. canChange already lists Facebook Page and Instagram messages, lead ad forms and Indeed applicants (settings-map.ts:681). manage_lead_intake's channel enum and description cover all seven (tools.ts:865-871). gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls → Business number → "Text me a test"
gaps.gap: "Text me a test" runs message.send with toPhone and acknowledgeQuietHours (test-text-dialog.tsx:28-46). send_text takes only personId or conversationId (tools.ts:1322-1331), and no Assistant tool or screen action takes a bare phone number. So a test to the person's own cell needs a customer record. Downgraded to low: it's a one-off check the person can press themselves, and no customer is affected.
gaps.fix: Fixed: send_test_text texts a test as Text me a test does, with the same words, to the number given or the person’s own confirmed cell. It waits on a card that says it’s a real text from the business number, and during quiet hours it goes only when asked to. With no confirmed cell and no number it asks for one (rule no_cell). The send’s own refusals, such as no business number yet, texting not approved or quiet hours, come before any card.

gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls → Calls: "Team browsers", the list of phones to ring (add one, remove one, switch one on or off, up to 3), "Ring for"
gaps.gap: The second half is already handled: update_texting_settings' description says "The calls settings are the default number’s, as on the screen" (tools.ts:617), and who each other number rings is manage_numbers choose_who_it_rings. gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls → "I already have a number I want to keep": GoHighLevel's "Check" then "Start watching for it"; My own Twilio account: "Show its numbers", "Bring it here", Disconnect
gaps.gap: Three steps are worker endpoints that no Assistant tool calls: the HighLevel "Check" (lookupNumberHost, /v1/telephony/number-host), listing a connected Twilio account's numbers for "Bring it here" (listTwilioNumbers, /v1/telephony/twilio/numbers), and Disconnect (disconnectTwilio, /v1/telephony/twilio/disconnect). Because they aren't commands, the coverage test doesn't see them. read_twilio_connection_list shows the connections, but not their numbers. Disconnecting isn't a sign-in, so no settled rule covers it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: check_number_host says where a number is, whether it’s in Twilio and how it would come here (with the keep-it-active and outside-US warnings); list_twilio_numbers lists a connected account’s numbers with what each is used by and whether it’s here or on its way; disconnect_twilio_account forgets one on a card that says its numbers here stay. They run the worker’s own number-import logic, as the person, with its permission checks. Connecting an account stays the person’s, with a handover.

gaps.where: Settings → Website chat → Look: Greeting (up to 500 characters, can be left empty); first set-up starts with "Hi, thanks for stopping by. How can we help?"
gaps.gap: manage_website_chat.greeting is text(300), which is min 1 and max 300 (tool-kit.ts:24, tools.ts:772). The worker's lookOf also drops an empty greeting through str(). On create, chat_widget.create stores greeting ?? null (commands/chat-widget.ts:106). The screen's set-up fills in 'Hi, thanks for stopping by. How can we help?' (website-chat-page.tsx:398), so a chat the Assistant makes starts with no greeting.
gaps.fix: Fixed: manage_website_chat’s greeting takes up to 500 characters, and an empty one clears it as emptying the box does (the card shows None). A new chat starts with the greeting the screen’s set-up fills in.

gaps.where: Settings → Texting & calls → RCS: "Stop renewing" and "Change the details"
gaps.gap: The Assistant can do both, and its tool says so. do_rcs_request_cancel is offered (coverage.ts:187), and its description, which comes from the command, reads "Give up on an RCS request that hasn’t been paid, or stop a paid one renewing: RCS stays on until the year paid for ends…" (commands/rcs-request.ts:231-233). So it won't say it can't stop renewing. What's missing is that settings-map texting canChange and onScreen name neither "Stop renewing" nor "Change the details". Nothing tells it that Change the details is a cancel followed by asking again, which is paid on Stripe and so stays the person's. SETTING_TOOLS 'texting.rcs' (coverage.ts:587-591) doesn't list do_rcs_request_cancel either.
gaps.fix: Fixed: settings-map texting canChange says I can stop RCS renewing, or cancel an unpaid request so its details can be changed (asking again and paying stay with the person), and onScreen names Stop renewing and Change the details. No SETTING_TOOLS row: do_rcs_request_cancel has no field once the business is put on server-side.
